data.message: I individually commit to 18 tons this month, not contingent on unanimity. Each Fisher01–25: opt in or state your exact catch and any conditions. Switching 10→18 earns $8,000 extra if fulfilled. If k choose18, others10: catch250+8k, stock250−8k; next stock500 (75%) or500−16k (25%). At k=25, 50 remain; next stock500 or100. This assumes those catches; other choices need recalculation. Intentions aren't enforceable; long-run gains aren't guaranteed. Will you choose18?
